stem: A business cancelled Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, in March 2026 and subscribed again in July at €40 a month. An analyst books the €40 in July as new-business MRR. What is the problem?

options.text: It is reactivation, so July's new business is overstated
It is expansion, because the business has paid before
Nothing: a business that cancelled counts as new when it returns
It is churn, because the business cancelled in March
